OCCUPATIONAL ENGLISH TEST
WRITING SUB-TEST               MEDICINE
TIME :                        READING: 5 MINUTES
                              WRITING : 40 MINUTES


Read the case notes below and complete the writing task which follows.
Notes:
You are a GP
Patient name: Ms Sarah Alexander
DOB: 15/11/2008
Age : 10 years
Social History:
Lives with her family. Has one brother
Past medical history: born pre-term then jaundiced - stayed at hospital for
3 days with no other medical issues
Mild asthma – since 2016
No head trauma
Medications: Salbutamol inhaler, pulmicort
Family history : no history of seizures , epilepsy
Allergy : dust ,pollen and cats
13/7/2017
Shortness of breath , wheezes, Cough on sport
 
Peak expiratory flow rate 14 L/m
Diagnosis: Asthma
Medication: salbutamol inhaler when required
Budesonide preventer 2 puffs daily
20/7/2019
- at 5 am: Her mother noticed left eye twitching then fell asleep
- at 8 am : eyes Staring for seconds , generalized jerking movement for 3-5
mins
neck twisted to left, her mother make her lying on her side
- she is anxious and wants to go different school.
Examination : afebrile , alert
Nil tongue biting , nil urine incontinence
Parents stated similar attacks for several weeks ( concern/upset)
Investigations :
ECG and FBE ordered
Diagnosis : ?Epilepsy
Plan : consult pediatric neurologist for assessment
Send pathological results to check
Reassurance of parents
Writing Task
Using the information in the case notes , write a letter of a referral to Dr
Melania Jackson . Address the letter to Dr Melania , Consultant Pediatric
neurologist ,Newtown Hospital , 81 Canyon Road , Newtown.
 
In your answer:
   Expand the relevant notes into complete sentences.
   Do not use note form.
   Use the letter form.
The body of the letter should be approximately 180 – 200 words.
